result.description: A fictional portable storage drive designed for creators and field engineers who need fast, bus-powered external storage. OrbitDock combines a rugged aluminum shell with a compact desk-friendly footprint, offering Thunderbolt 4 connectivity, USB4 compatibility, and sustained high-speed transfers for large project files, video caches, and backups. It emphasizes quiet operation, shock resistance, and cross-platform use with desktops, laptops, and workstations.
